name: YuJian Design System V3.1 Shared Foundation

shared_foundation.rule: All seven systems must be READY; REVIEW does not pass.

systems.reason: Brand calligraphic intent, Android SansSerif mapping, and OS fallback / page overrides require owner review.
Known global and shared component values are registered; shared Success/Warning/Error colors are missing and no exhaustive literal-color orphan scan is complete.
Viewport / Insets / IME rules are documented; page-level Normal Home anchors, Result glass and Login IME remain review items.
Five V1 roles, master source, SHA, treatment and page inheritance are registered.
43/43 SVG frozen masters and hashes complete; Android mapping is outside this design-only task.
Navigation / Actions / Media contracts mapped; shared data/input contracts remain page-scoped or partial.
658 files have Git object identity; 50 SHA-256 values are not present in the audited registry.

phase3.block: No module enters formal Page Contract Freeze before SHARED_FOUNDATION_READY.
